        <<example>>

    Connection *-- ConnectionMethod : nested

    Connection ..> ConnectionKeyVal : uses

    Connection ..> RequestAuthenticator : auth()
    ConnectionBase <|-- ConnectionRequest
    ConnectionBase <|-- ConnectionResponse
    ConnectionRequest --> ConnectionKeyVal : data()
    ConnectionResponse ..> StreamParser : streamParser()
    ConnectionResponse ..> Document : parse()

    %% Implementations of Connection
    Connection <|.. HttpConnection
    ConnectionBase <|.. HttpConnectionBase

    ConnectionKeyVal <|.. HttpConnectionKeyVal

    HttpConnectionBase <|-- HttpConnectionResponse
